test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. P, Q, R and S are seated in the same row facing south. L, M, N and O are seated in the same row facing north. L sits to the extreme left of the row and faces R who sits exactly opposite him. P sits second to the left of R and is exactly opposite O. M sits at the extreme right of their row and is exactly opposite S. Who sits exactly opposite Q?
solution:
Explanation:

Row 1: L, M, N and O facing the North.

Row 2: P, Q, R and S facing the South.

1) L sits to the extreme left of the row and faces R who sits exactly opposite him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4804f3d312bc92da27de4d49390435ff9b528708b76e58213a62424a346f73db.png] 

2) P sits second to the left of R and is exactly opposite O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8e17ccd48c3340d84e81e79f225bf0ff97031022c6797f57b2111aaf898ab6d.png] 

3) M sits at the extreme right of their row and is exactly opposite S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9979506a9b6f8a0c632e35abdb4cf88e3f72d72f36c891de695fa6b539c1552.png] 

4) Final sitting arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fc178a171db014dc01422c8a4bd586fe3447722e7c4af84d9cf23db73abc2e8.png] 

Hence, "N" sits exactly opposite Q.
